note: Captured ordinal-zero (A0.4) from the unmodified managed StyledLineTileBuilder.WriteMeshData oracle, before any line-graph production edit. Stream0 (Position+Normal), Stream1 (Across), Stream2 (Side+DistanceAlong) are per-vertex hex IEEE-754; Indices and Stream3 (colour+widthScale) are frozen whole-stream SHA-256 digests, structurally independent of the projection. Re-baked 2026-09-07 (UMR-96): a CONSTANT paint colour is no longer baked into the COLOR stream — it rides the _BaseColor uniform and the vertex carries the white identity. ONLY the colour field moved; every other stream is unchanged. That field now pins the OPPOSITE fact it used to: it reads white BECAUSE a constant colour is not baked, so a regression that re-introduces the bake puts the styled colour back into the stream and fails here.
format: each float is an 8-hex-digit IEEE-754 bit pattern (math.asuint), comma-separated, read back via math.asfloat
